title: Difference
text: After parting ways with my Father, I discreetly made my way out of the castle town and headed toward a nearby village. Yuki-chan and the others are chirping cheerfully. From here on out, securing food will be crucial for a while. Normally, I’d start by feeding them something soft, let their levels rise rapidly, and then give them a hearty meal.

That instinct to eat until their stomachs burst… it’s enough to satisfy the Filolial-sama when they’re crying out from hunger. But right now, I can’t push them too hard. I’ll procure some soft food in a nearby village and feed them little by little so they can endure their hunger.

Smiling, I slowly trudged on foot toward the village that day. I left the castle town just after noon, and by the time I arrived at the second town after walking at a leisurely pace, the sun was beginning to set. Since I didn’t force my way into the guild, it seems the assassins haven’t arrived yet. It would be a problem if they’ve gone after my Father, but since it’s his orders, there’s nothing I can do.

I checked into an inn in the second town, and after finishing dinner with Yuki-chan and the others—who haven’t grown any bigger yet—I went to rest in my room. The important part comes after this, after all. Then, I took a nap for a few hours.
“Well then.”

That night, I woke up with a start and arranged the bed to look as if I were still asleep. Then, being careful not to wake Yuki-chan and the others, I gently lifted them in my arms, slipped into a dark corner of the room as if hiding, and cast my Skills.
“Portal Spear”

In an instant, my field of vision shifted from the inn room… to the never-sleeping town of Siltvelt. Once I’m this far, there’s no need for caution or anything like that. I dashed off with a flourish, careful not to wake Yuki-chan and the others. My target was a dangerous and powerful monster deep in the mountains of Siltvelt.

Passersby looked at me with eyes that said, “It’s rare to see a human adventurer in Siltvelt,” but I didn’t care. I ran on the sheer momentum of my high level. And I raced forward, illuminating the dark night path with fire Magic.

I finally encountered what looked like some powerful monsters. Compared to Melromarc, they’re all a different breed. Well, since I’ve already ravaged this area to raise the Filolial-sama I bought up from the monster merchant to get Filo-tan, it feels like my own backyard by now.
“Meteor Thrust! Brionac! Gungnir! Aiming Lancer!　Hahaha, they’re weak! Way too weak, waaaaaaah!”

As if to vent all my pent-up frustration, I spent the night hunting down and finishing off the monsters. Oh? This time, a dragon I defeated dropped some armor. If I wear this and walk around, people will definitely get suspicious.

Besides, it’s not really my style. As for the spear, I’ll follow Father’s instructions and wait until I’ve rented a room from the weapon shop owner before I take it out. What should I do with the materials? For now, I’ll chop them up into small pieces and give them to Father later.
The timing of when I hand this over to Father is crucial, too. I suppose I’ll hide it deep in these mountains for now? It shouldn’t be a problem even if it gets stolen.
“‘Peep!’”
“Oh? Have they woken up?”
“‘Peep!’”

Yuki-chan and the others, who were supposed to be asleep, woke up, chirped cheerfully, and started pecking at the monster’s meat I was butchering. It’s a heartwarming sight. However, having to act with Father’s safety in mind and to avoid starting a war is an absolute pain in the neck. Isn’t there a way I can just wipe out the Crimson Swine, the Pope, and all the Trash without having to think about it? With thoughts like these, I continued hunting until just before dawn.
“Phew… I almost forgot to factor in the time difference.”

After returning to the inn in Melromarc via portal, I slipped back into my room as if hiding. Well, it’s not really a “time difference” worth mentioning, but it would be a hassle if they figured out the sleeping me was an imposter.
“‘Piyo!’”

By this point, Yuki-chan and the others had gradually come into their own and grown to their second forms. They’re Level 28 now. As expected, it was difficult to level them up entirely just during the night. If I fight for too long, they’ll get suspicious, so I have no choice but to proceed like this, as if I were hiding.
“‘Piyo!’”
Yuki-chan and the others started complaining that they were hungry.
“I understand.”

Well, hunting monsters to feed Yuki-chan and the others isn’t really a problem. I headed back down the road I’d taken to the castle town to meet up with my Father. Along the way, I looked for monsters and gathered some food for Yuki-chan and the others. I’ll also bring a few other materials as a gift for my Father.
“Hello, Motoyasu-kun. What a coincidence.”
Just as planned, I met up with my Father in front of the apothecary in Melromarc’s castle town.
“‘Piyo!’”
“Wow… So these are the Filolials from yesterday? They’ve gotten quite big, haven’t they?”
“They’re still growing.”
“I hear that’s true. I guess it’ll take a little while longer before they’re big enough to pull a carriage, huh?”
As he said that, my father leaned in close to my ear.
“So? Did everything go well?”
“No problems at all. Yuki-chan and the others are now Level 29.”
“That was fast!”
“By the way, I managed to get some armor that looks good for you, Father, but that’ll have to wait a bit.”

“I see. Oh, right. Motoyasu-kun told me to keep an eye on the apothecary, so I’ve started to figure out a bit about medicinal herbs. After we left yesterday, I went out to the grasslands to look for some.”
With that, Father showed me the medicinal herbs.
“Do Yuki-chan and the others want some too?”
Father shared the medicinal herbs with Yuki-chan and the others and let them eat them. However, perhaps they didn’t suit her taste, because Yuki-chan ended up spitting them right back out.
“Oops…”
“I’m so sorry.”

“It’s okay, it’s okay. Once I put them in my shield, a ‘Gathering’ skill appeared and the quality seemed to improve, so I got carried away and picked way too many. I’m just relaxing by the nearby river, fishing and such. Maybe I’ll try my hand at alchemy today.”
“Have any assassins shown up yet?”
“Not yet… but who knows. I’m being very careful about what I eat.”
That’s right. Since I ended up protecting my Father, there’s no telling how things might change, so we need to stay vigilant.
“Peep!”
“Ah, that’s right. Sakura-chan.”
My Father showed me a tiny, pink Filolial-sama curled up in his pocket.
“She hatched from an egg just before we met up with Motoyasu-kun. Want to take a look?”
“Yes, please.”
“Peep!”
Sakura-chan, introduced by my Father, turned toward me cheerfully. Hmm?
“Her eyes are blue, aren’t they?”
“Huh? Her eye color? Is she okay?”

Am I misremembering something? I’m pretty sure Sakura-chan’s eye color is pink, just like her body color… and then it turns cherry blossom pink. But the color of Sakura-chan’s eyes that my Father showed me was blue… Could this be a different Filolial-sama?

I took a whiff of Sakura-chan. Sakura-chan’s scent has a certain quality that vaguely reminds me of Filo-tan. Well, since Filo-tan is white with a cherry blossom hue, it’s completely the opposite, isn’t it?
Could this… perhaps be due to an acquired influence from Filolial-sama? It seems there’s a difference in Sakura-chan’s eye color depending on whether I hatch her or my Father does.

I don’t know the reason for this change, though… Come to think of it… among the Filolials people have been raising, there was one whose coloration differed from its body color. Perhaps even the foster parent can cause variations in this regard.

I’ve learned something new. Well, either way, Sakura-chan’s body color is the opposite of Filo-tan’s, so there’s no need to panic. Filo-tan will eventually be stocked at the Monster Merchant’s tent, and if my Father or I don’t buy one, someone else will snap it up. We just need to stop by regularly and collect them.
“No problem at all. Well then…”
Peppe and Yuki-chan have gotten grumpy because the medicinal herbs taste bad. They say “good medicine tastes bitter,” but a newborn Filolial-sama probably wouldn’t understand that.
“I’ll take care of Sakura-chan and level her up. In the meantime, I’d like you to look after Kou.”
“Right. So, Sakura-chan, go get stronger with Motoyasu-kun for a little while.”
“Pii!”
“Piyo!”
As if to say, “Got it!” Kou and Sakura-chan chirped in unison, almost as if they were saluting.
“Well then… let’s head over to the slave trader’s place.”
With a serious expression, Father spoke up. That’s right. Today, we were supposed to hear from the slave trader just how much it would cost to procure a slave.
“That’s right. However, I think Yuki-chan and the others might not like the monster trader’s tent, so I’ll have them wait outside.”
“Yeah. It should be fine to leave them there for a bit. Let’s go, then.”
Together with Father, we made our way through the back alleys toward the monster trader’s tent.
